card.name: Suicidality warning text on antiepileptics and antidepressants
card.fires_on: Linking or closing words in the suicidal thoughts and behavior warning, such as "that" after "suggests", "concern" in "long-standing concern", and the period after "untreated illness". It fires where a clause about risk is about to follow.

modes.label: That after suggests
modes.description: The word "that" after "suggests" in the sentence about increased risk across all antiepileptic drugs.
modes.example: across a range of indications suggests<< that>> the risk applies to all AEDs

modes.label: Concern about antidepressants
modes.description: The word "concern" in the sentence on the long-standing worry that antidepressants may play a role in suicidality.
modes.example: There has been a long-standing<< concern>> that antidepressants may have a role in

modes.label: End of risk-balance sentence
modes.description: The period ending the sentence on weighing suicidal risk against untreated illness.
modes.example: with the risk of untreated illness<<.>> Epilepsy and many

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed, and the suppressed ones are words like outcome and consequences.
